utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — we could use another set of hands sorting donations and loading boxes. If you’re free, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m free, and I’d be glad to help sort donations and load boxes. Just tell me when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a screwdriver set and check the wiring on the repair drive first? If you notice anything loose or damaged, let me know before you tighten it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely — I’ll bring a screwdriver set and check the wiring first. If I spot anything loose or damaged, I’ll let you know before touching it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supply list ready for the repair drive. What do you need me to check first?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Could you check what tools we already have? I might be forgetting something.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the tools we already have and flag anything missing. I’ll get back to you with the list soon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help however I can with the repair drive. What’s the main thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m mostly trying to keep the list and timing straight. If you can help coordinate the pickup and let me know when you’re available, that’d really ease my mind.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I can help coordinate the pickup. I’m available this afternoon and tomorrow morning, so just tell me what time works best.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell — is the repair drive still on for Saturday, and do you need me to bring any tools?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mina — yes, I heard it’s still on for Saturday, but I’m not totally sure about the tool list yet. If you’ve got a basic set, that’d be really helpful.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — I’ll bring my basic tool set on Saturday. If you get the list before then, just send it over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve heard a few folks mention the repair drive — looks like it’s getting some attention around the neighborhood. I’ll keep my ears open and pass along anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Nice, Tess — appreciate it. If you hear anyone who needs a hand, I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s kind of you, Gus — I’ll spread the word if I hear anyone who could use them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll pass the word around about the repair drive. If you want, I can help get a few neighbors lined up too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn—that would be really helpful. I’ll keep track of who’s lined up and where they’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it—I’ll start spreading the word right away and see who can pitch in. I’ll let you know as soon as I have a few names.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what time you need me there?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Could you come by at 10 a.m.?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m putting together the repair drive list and lining up volunteers now. If you’ve got any urgent fixes, send them my way and I’ll add them in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll send over any urgent fixes I know about. Thanks for organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. I’ll keep you posted as the list comes together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive to folks and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Let’s keep it simple: mention it to folks, and I’ll help with the list if needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll mention the repair drive to folks and keep it moving, and I’ll let you know if we need help with the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—sorry, I’m a bit scatterbrained today. I’m happy to help; what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. If you can bring a hammer and some screws, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You got it — I’ll bring a hammer and some screws. If I forget, feel free to give me a nudge!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and point me to anyone who needs small repairs? I’m running errands later, so I can drop off flyers or pick up a few names.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and ask around for anyone who needs help. I can text you a few names once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—if you’re free, I’d love to have you come by and pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Quinn, I might be able to swing by late and help out a bit—just let me know when you need me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Dane—late works perfectly. I’ll let you know the exact time and can point you to whatever needs doing when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: A little help sorting the donations would be great. If you can swing by tomorrow morning, I’ll have everything laid out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can swing by tomorrow morning and help sort the donations.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I can work around the school pickup window, but I’ll need the repair drive time first. If you have the details, send them over and I’ll fit it in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair drive time over as soon as I have it. Thanks for being flexible.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — once you have the time, I’ll line it up around pickup. Thanks, Mara.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I’m glad the repair drive’s coming together — I can help connect folks if you need a hand. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great, Jules — I’m planning to start by spreading the word and lining up a few volunteers. If you can connect me with neighbors who might pitch in, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and introduce you to a few neighbors who are usually up for helping. Send me the details, and I’ll start spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that’d help a lot. I just want to make sure we’ve got everything lined up before the repair drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — tell me what’s still missing, and I’ll see if I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of the repair drive locations—what spots are we covering first?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — let’s start with Maple Street, the corner by the park, and then the duplexes on Birch. I’ll keep the list updated as we go.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll start with Maple Street, then the corner by the park, and the duplexes on Birch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, is the repair drive still on for this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes—it's still on for Saturday. I’m just double-checking the details, so I’ll confirm the time and place before then.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks. Just let me know the time and place when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Could you bring a few rolls of duct tape, a box of screws, and your drill if you have it? I’ll handle the supply list and set things out for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll bring duct tape, screws, and my drill. I’ll see you there and help wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve mostly just heard bits and pieces, but I’m glad the repair drive is happening. What still needs the most help?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not totally sure, honestly—I’ve been a bit out of the loop. I think they still need people for the bigger fixes, though.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I'll keep my ears open and see if I can find out what big fixes they need most.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is definitely happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s definitely happening — folks are already talking about it. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — can you confirm the date once you hear it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m happy to help; just remind me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We still need a few tools sorted and the drop-off table set up. If you can, just show up around noon and help me organize it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No problem — I’ll be there around noon and help sort the tools and set up the table.
